title: Trader paper book has no paper worker; it must run trader intents only

problem_register_ref.section: RC4. Nobody looks at the whole design
problem_register_ref.row: Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader (SD-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-CAPABILITIES-20261127 T7/T8 follow-up)

root_cause.desired_state_exclusion: services/control-plane/bff/personas/trader_paper_book.py::ensure_trader_paper_book coordinated Registry/Governance/Deployment authorities when configured but deployed the RuntimeBinding to Runtime-Manager without attaching the approved artifact execution projection (object_store, artifact_checksum, symbol, market_data_policy) produced by StagePlanner.build_execution_projection. As a result, services/runtime-manager/fleet_desired_state.py::_execution_projection_exclusion_reason excluded rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e with exclusion_reason='non_executable_missing_artifact_store' and paper-fleet-reconciler spawned no paper_runtime.py worker for rt-persona-paper-3ca8da543bef6ede0a07.
root_cause.strategy_signal_isolation: Once a trader servant paper book RuntimeBinding carries the approved artifact execution projection so desired-state admits it and paper-fleet-reconciler runs its worker subprocess, paper-signal-producer must not evaluate the bootstrap close_to_close_momentum StrategyArtifact on that binding; a trader servant paper book executes only trader-confirmed paper intents enqueued by the T8 consumer (source_worker == 'paper-signal-producer.agora-intent').

changes.summary: Added PersonaProvisioningCoordinator.build_paper_execution_projection_metadata(record, ids, deployment_plan_receipt=..., registry_receipt=...) reusing StagePlanner().build_execution_projection(plan_obj, entry), validate_strategy_artifact, strategy_artifact_checksum, and strategy_artifact_minimum_closes (the exact projection path used by DeploymentService.create_plan).

Updated ensure_trader_paper_book to attach the StagePlanner.build_execution_projection metadata (object_store, strategy_id, artifact_checksum, symbol='2330.TW' for TWD books, market_data_policy) on new RuntimeBinding creation and to repair existing active bindings lacking the projection (such as hosted rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e) in place on the same binding_id via RuntimeManagerClient.transition without creating a second pool, capital binding, or RuntimeBinding. Kept read_trader_paper_book (GET /bff/agora/servant/paper-book) strictly read-only with zero Runtime-Manager transitions or owner writes, and preserved deliberately paused bindings (failing closed with reason_code='runtime_binding_not_active' and zero transitions).

Added TRADER_SERVANT_PAPER_BOOK_KIND = 'trader_servant_paper_book' and _is_trader_servant_paper_book_binding(binding), called once per binding at the start of PaperSignalProducer._produce_current so paper-signal-producer produces zero strategy decisions and zero strategy signals for trader servant paper book bindings while leaving settle_pending_intraday and the three trading personas' signal production untouched.
Unchanged (zero exemption list added); trader servant paper book bindings pass _execution_projection_exclusion_reason via the standard StagePlanner.build_execution_projection metadata.

Added TestTraderServantPaperBookIntentOnlyAndPersonaSettlement covering AC3 (zero strategy decisions and zero strategy signals on an executable trader book binding while preserving T8 paper-signal-producer.agora-intent signals) and AC4 (the three trading personas' pending_settlement parking and settle_pending_intraday D+1 open release unchanged).
Recorded PAPER-TRADER-BOOK-EXECUTABLE-INTENT-ONLY-20261127 (owner Antigravity, cross-family reviewer Codex) in the RC4 Agora servant row.

paper_worker_subprocess_memory.measurement_method: Spawned PaperFleetReconciler parent process plus 4 real PaperRuntimeService subprocesses (rt-49c1c3d1 + 3 trading personas qinghe, hengyue, chengchuan) and then added the 5th subprocess for rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e (rt-persona-paper-3ca8da543bef6ede0a07), reading VmHWM (peak RSS) and VmRSS from /proc/<pid>/status after draining heartbeat/fill cycles and persisting ledger + outbox state.
paper_worker_subprocess_memory.measurement_command: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -c '<spawn PaperFleetReconciler + 4 baseline PaperRuntimeService worker subprocesses + 5th trader paper book worker subprocess rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e; read /proc/<pid>/status VmHWM/VmRSS and stat ledger/outbox files>'
paper_worker_subprocess_memory.comparison_with_hosted_cgroup_limit: Measured 4-worker + reconciler process VmHWM sum is 267.86 MiB (hosted cgroup baseline in docs/deployment/evidence/DEV-COMPOSE-MEMORY-LIMITS-PEAK-SIZED-20261117/evidence.json:14 is 253 MiB anon + 382 MiB page cache = 640 MiB cgroup peak). Adding the 5th worker adds 53.78 MiB VmHWM (321.64 MiB total process VmHWM; ~694 MiB projected cgroup peak including the 382 MiB page cache), leaving ~586 MiB headroom below the 1280 MiB container memory cap (DEV_MEM_LIMIT_PAPER_FLEET_RECONCILER:-1280m in docker-compose.yml:2981).
paper_worker_subprocess_memory.cleanup: PaperFleetReconciler._terminate_worker (services/paper_fleet_reconciler/paper_fleet_reconciler.py:1218-1277) terminates the worker subprocess on binding pause, retirement, or desired-state exclusion (SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL after RECONCILER_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=10s).

telemetry_heartbeat_and_summary_rows_per.retention_and_cap: HeartbeatRetentionJob (services/telemetry/heartbeat_retention.py, running every 300s in services/telemetry/main.py with <=20 batches x 5000 rows per event class) rolls up and deletes raw heartbeat rows older than PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_HEARTBEAT_RAW_RETENTION_DAYS=3 days (capping steady-state raw heartbeat rows for one runtime at 3 x 5760 = 17,280 rows), deletes runtime_state_snapshot rows older than PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_STATE_SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS=3 days (preserving newest/oldest per runtime and unknown-valuation anchors), and deletes unreferenced non-permanent telemetry_events older than PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS=14 days, keeping public.telemetry_events within its 5 GB / <=100 MB/day cap in scripts/measure_hosted_storage.py.

code_references: services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py:6178 (self._ledger_fill_history = self._ledger_fill_history[-256:], RAM-only, not persisted in ledger JSON)
per_binding_performance_ledger_file.write_cadence: Atomic in-place snapshot rewrite via atomic_write_text (single deterministic <path>.tmp sibling; sweep_stale_temp_siblings on startup) on fill commit, mark valuation update, or performance pair stage/ack (0 writes/day when idle with no trader intents).
per_binding_performance_ledger_file.steady_state_size_and_structural_bound: PaperExecutionAlgorithm._persist_state (paper_runtime.py:6506-6575) has no hardcoded byte-size limit; it is structurally bounded because every write replaces the file in place with scalar account fields plus maps keyed only by currently non-zero holdings (paper_runtime.py:6528-6532), active open_episodes (6533-6545), tracked execution_prices (6546-6550), instrument_positions (6551-6557), settled_futures_contracts (6565), at most one pending_performance_pair (cleared on ack_performance_pair at 6781-6795), and in-flight pending_fill_publications (drained to [] on ack_fill_publication at 6697-6714; _ledger_fill_history is RAM-only and not persisted). Measured ledger size is 674 B idle and 1,331 B with an open 2330.TW position (0 B/day net growth when idle or after positions close and publications are acked). The sibling LifecycleTelemetryOutbox file is pruned on load, admit, admit_many, and acknowledge_many by _prune_expired_chains (paper_runtime.py:7322-7348), which removes any journey with no pending events whose last correlation_envelope.event_time is older than _chain_retention_seconds() (default _LIFECYCLE_CHAIN_RETENTION_DEFAULT_SECONDS = 35 days = 3,024,000s at paper_runtime.py:130, configurable via PANTHEON_LIFECYCLE_CHAIN_RETENTION_SECONDS, chosen to outlive the 30-day signal store decision TTL); measured outbox size is 110 B idle and 26,953 B (~26.3 KiB) with 35 retained journey checkpoints across the 35-day window (~767 B per journey checkpoint).
per_binding_performance_ledger_file.cleanup: PaperFleetReconciler._cleanup_retired_state_files (services/paper_fleet_reconciler/paper_fleet_reconciler.py:1299-1425) unlinks the per-binding ledger file, .lifecycle-outbox.json, .member-books.json, .lock, and any .tmp siblings once the binding is retired in Runtime-Manager, not in desired-state, has no live worker, and its pending fill publications, pending performance pair, and outbox pending list are empty.
